headline: Executive order lets former AmeriCorps members be hired into certain federal jobs through a special appointment process.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up a way for people who served in AmeriCorps to be appointed to jobs in the federal competitive service. The competitive service covers many regular federal government jobs that normally require applicants to compete through the standard hiring process. No summary was provided, so details such as eligibility rules, time limits, and which jobs are covered are not known from the source.

who_it_affects.how: They may gain a special path to be appointed to federal competitive service jobs.
They would have an added option for appointing AmeriCorps alumni to competitive service positions.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 16, 2025; the source does not give a separate start date.
